account-locked: Jatebɔsɛbɛn datugura waati dɔ kɔnɔ, sabu donni fililen caman kɛra. Aw ye a lajɛ kokura kɔfɛ.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ye SuperAdmin dama ta ye, Cloud Panel Domɛni kan.
cloud-settings-desc: Ni WeKan ye Weddy kɔnɔ, Cloud Panel bɛ WeKan domɛni caman baara ka bɔ server kelen na, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ ni a yɛrɛ ka kunnafoniw. Cloud Panel Domɛni kan, SuperAdmin bɛ domɛniw ni CloudFlare ɲɛmɔgɔya.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ni CloudFlare API kilé ye, domɛni min ka zone bɛ i ka CloudFlare jatebɔ la, o bɛ proxy DNS sɛbɛn ni CloudFlare Origin sɛbɛn sɔrɔ. Domɛni tɔw bɛ Let's Encrypt sɛbɛn sɔrɔ. Kilé bɛ mara server kan, a tɛna jira tugun abada.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: CloudFlare API kilé si ma mara: domɛni bɛɛ bɛ Let's Encrypt sɛbɛn sɔrɔ.
error-ldap-login: Fili dɔ kɛra donni lajɛli la
error-notAuthorized: I ma yamaruya ka ɲɛ in lajɛ.
title: Kunnafoni kuntigi
